title: Proper immersions are closed immersions
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes which is proper (separated, of finite type and universally closed, [def-weil-proper-morphism], as in [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]) and an immersion (it factors as a closed immersion $X\to U$ followed by an open immersion $U\to Y$, [def-weil-closed-immersion], [def-weil-open-immersion]). Then the image $f(X)$ is a closed subset of $Y$, and $f$ is a closed immersion. (Only universal closedness of $f$ is used.)

source.place: node lem-weil-pbc-proper-immersion-closed, order 1060; Stacks: Schemes, Lemma Tag 01IQ (lemma-immersion-when-closed) with Morphisms, Definition Tag 01U2; the same deduction in Morphisms, Lemma Tag 01W6 (lemma-image-proper-scheme-closed) and in the proof of Morphisms, lemma-proper-ample-locally-projective

proof.text: $f(X)$ is closed. By [def-weil-proper-morphism] $f$ is universally closed: for every $Y'\to Y$ the base change $X\times_YY'\to Y'$ is a closed map. Take $Y'=Y$ with the identity: $X\times_YY\cong X$ and the base change is $f$ itself, so $f$ is a closed map of underlying spaces and $f(X)$, the image of the closed set $X$, is closed in $Y$.

source.place: Morphisms, Definition Tag 01U2 (definition-universally-closed); Lemma Tag 01W6, last sentence

proof.text: $f$ is a closed immersion. By [def-weil-closed-immersion] write $f=j\circ i$ with $i:X\to U$ a closed immersion and $j:U\to Y$ an open immersion onto an open $U\subseteq Y$ [def-weil-open-immersion]. An immersion whose image is closed is a closed immersion [lem-weil-pbc-immersion-closed-image-closed-immersion], and $f(X)$ is closed by step 1. (Stacks' proof of 01IQ: the ideal sheaf $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_U$ of $i$ and the unit ideal $\mathcal O_{Y\setminus f(X)}$ agree on $U\setminus f(X)$ and glue to a quasi-coherent ideal $\mathcal J\subseteq\mathcal O_Y$ whose closed subscheme is $X$.)

split_report.summary: Decided as a Mathlib leaf: no single Mathlib declaration, but IsClosedImmersion.of_isPreimmersion f f.isClosedMap.isClosed_range gives both clauses in one line from [IsProper f] [IsImmersion f]. Statement made self-contained (proper and immersion spelled out with their definition nodes; stmt_deps add def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-open-immersion); meaning unchanged. The imported proof was rewritten: it factored the immersion as an open immersion followed by a closed immersion, which is not the definition fixed in def-weil-closed-immersion / def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions (closed immersion followed by open immersion; the other order is not equivalent in general, Stacks 01QW), and it used lem-weil-pbc-proper-closed-image of unit sk-thm-br, which sk-thm-chow does not cite. New proof follows Stacks: closed image from universal closedness (Morphisms 01U2, base change along the identity; elementary) and Schemes 01IQ, now the new Mathlib-leaf node lem-weil-pbc-immersion-closed-image-closed-immersion.
